name: Policy Q&A held-out evaluation set (30 queries) - clean set for Phase 7

supersedes.note: v1.0 is kept unchanged as an immutable record (manifests/eval-dataset.sha256).

changes_from_1_0.reason: EV-06 was exposed: retrieval was accidentally run on it during Phase 6 (two CLI runs and two mocked unit tests). It is excluded from the clean set and kept in eval_queries_exposed.json for transparency and optional sensitivity analysis.
changes_from_1_0.unchanged: The other 29 queries are copied from v1.0 without any modification.

purpose: Held-out evaluation of RAG v1 vs v2 (Phase 7). Never used for tuning chunking, BM25, RRF, reranking, thresholds or prompts. The 5 development queries (dev_queries.json) remain the only tuning/debugging set.
corpus: data/policies (6 synthetic Brightlake Systems policies; manifests/corpus.sha256)
labelling_rules: required_evidence: list of groups; each group is one fact the answer needs; IDs inside a group are interchangeable sentences (any one satisfies the group).
Only canonical evidence IDs are used (never chunk IDs), so labels are independent of the chunking strategy.
expected_policy_ids = the policies that contain the required evidence.
answer_terms: list of groups of acceptable phrasings; every group must be matched by the answer (case-insensitive). Each term occurs verbatim in the required evidence text (checked by the validator).
Unanswerable queries have no required evidence and no answer terms; the expected behaviour is a refusal. absent_terms lists topic words verified to be absent from the corpus.
No query reuses a fact required by a development query. Labels were written from the policy text before any retrieval system was run on these queries.

queries.question: How much time off for being ill do I get each year?
queries.reference_answer: Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year.
queries.notes: 'time off for being ill' paraphrases 'sick leave'; annual leave (20 days) in the same policy is a numeric distractor.

queries.question: If a close family member dies, how many paid days off am I allowed?
queries.reference_answer: Up to 5 working days of paid bereavement leave following the death of an immediate family member.
queries.notes: The word 'bereavement' is not in the question.

queries.question: Can I get paid out in cash for vacation days I never used?
queries.reference_answer: No. Unused annual leave cannot be exchanged for cash, except as part of final settlement when an employee leaves the company.
queries.notes: 'vacation days' vs 'annual leave'. The carry-forward rules (same section) are near-topic.

queries.question: How fast do I have to reply to messages when I am working remotely?
queries.reference_answer: During core hours, employees working from home must respond to messages within 30 minutes.
queries.notes: 'working remotely' vs 'working from home'; HR-002 section 8 (another country) also says 'remotely'.

queries.question: Am I allowed to read my personal email on my company laptop?
queries.reference_answer: Yes, limited personal use such as reading personal email during breaks is permitted, provided it does not interfere with work or breach any company policy.
queries.notes: Answer is permission with conditions.

queries.question: Do I have to use the Brightlake Authenticator app for MFA?
queries.reference_answer: Yes. Users must use the Brightlake Authenticator mobile app as their second factor.
queries.notes: Acronym 'MFA' and product name.

queries.question: According to HR-004, how long is the probation period?
queries.reference_answer: The probation period for new employees is 6 months.
queries.notes: Policy-code query. HR-002 section 2 mentions probation (eligibility to work from home) but not its length.

queries.question: Under IT-002, can I plug in my own USB stick?
queries.reference_answer: No. USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops by default; only encrypted USB drives issued by the IT department may be used.
queries.notes: Policy code plus 'USB'; two adjacent sentences are needed for a complete answer.

queries.question: By what date do carried-over leave days have to be used?
queries.reference_answer: Carried-forward days must be used by 31 March of the following year; unused ones expire.
queries.notes: Overlaps a fact of Day 12 smoke question SM-02 (different wording).

queries.question: What is the deadline for requesting work-from-home days?
queries.reference_answer: Work-from-home days must be requested in the HR Portal by 17:00 on the Friday of the preceding week.
queries.notes: HR-001 leave-request notice periods (7 / 21 days) are near-topic distractors.

queries.question: What mileage rate is paid when I use my own car for business travel?
queries.reference_answer: USD 0.40 per kilometre.
queries.notes: 'own car' vs 'personal vehicle'.

queries.question: Above what amount does an expense claim also need the department head's approval?
queries.reference_answer: Claims above USD 1,000 also require approval from the department head.
queries.notes: The USD 25 receipt threshold in section 2 is a numeric distractor.

queries.question: How many of my previous passwords am I not allowed to reuse?
queries.reference_answer: Users must not reuse any of their previous 10 passwords.
queries.notes: Same section contains other numbers (14 characters, 180 days).

queries.question: How many public holidays are there and when is the list published?
queries.reference_answer: Brightlake Systems publishes a list of 12 public holidays each December for the following calendar year.
queries.notes: Two facts in one sentence.

queries.question: How long is paid maternity leave, and how much prior service do I need to be eligible?
queries.reference_answer: 26 weeks of paid maternity leave; the employee must have completed at least 80 days of service in the 12 months before the expected delivery date.
queries.notes: Paternity leave (same section) is a near-topic distractor.

queries.question: What happens after five wrong sign-in attempts, and what if my account gets locked again the same day?
queries.reference_answer: The account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed sign-in attempts; if it is locked again within 24 hours it stays locked until the IT Service Desk unlocks it.
queries.notes: IT-001-S04-E01 is split by fixed_500 chunking (Phase 2), so that strategy cannot deliver it intact. Overlaps Day 12 smoke SM-09.

queries.question: When I leave the company, how soon must I hand back my equipment, and what happens if I don't?
queries.reference_answer: All company equipment must be returned within 5 working days of the last working day; the cost of unreturned equipment may be deducted from the final settlement.
queries.notes: HR-001 final settlement (leave cash-out) is near-topic. Overlaps Day 12 smoke SM-11.

queries.question: By when must I tell my manager that I am sick, and when do I need a doctor's note?
queries.reference_answer: Notify the line manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence; a medical certificate is required for any sick absence longer than 2 consecutive working days.
queries.notes: 'doctor's note' vs 'medical certificate'. HR-001-S04-E03 is split by fixed_500 chunking (Phase 2). Overlaps Day 12 smoke SM-03.

queries.question: As a hybrid-eligible employee, what internet allowance do I get and how many days a week can I work from home?
queries.reference_answer: A monthly internet allowance of USD 40 paid through payroll, and up to 2 work-from-home days per week.
queries.notes: Facts in sections 3 and 7 of HR-002. Overlaps Day 12 smoke SM-04.

queries.question: How long must my password be, and are SMS codes accepted as a second factor?
queries.reference_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long; SMS codes are not an approved MFA method.
queries.notes: Facts in sections 2 and 3 of IT-001. Overlaps Day 12 smoke SM-08.

queries.question: What happens on a new employee's first day, and which courses must they finish within their first two weeks?
queries.reference_answer: On their first day new employees attend an orientation session that starts at 09:30; within 14 calendar days of joining they must complete Security Awareness Training and Code of Conduct Training.
queries.notes: 'two weeks' vs '14 calendar days'. HR-004-S03-E02 (laptop, badge, accounts) is not an alternative because the sentence alone does not say 'first day'. IT-002 (laptop on or before the first working day) is near-topic. Overlaps Day 12 smoke SM-12.

queries.question: What email address should I use for HR questions, and where do I submit expense claims?
queries.reference_answer: HR questions go to the HR Operations team at hr-ops@brightlake.example; expense claims are submitted through the Expense Portal (within 30 calendar days of the expense).
queries.notes: The HR contact sentence appears in three policies (any one satisfies group 1); the Expense Portal is only in HR-003. HR-003's own contact (Finance team, expenses@brightlake.example) is a distractor for the e-mail part.

queries.question: Do I need to submit receipts to get the internet allowance?
queries.reference_answer: No. No receipts are required for the internet allowance.
queries.notes: Strong distractor: HR-003 receipt rules (receipt above USD 25; fuel receipts) use the same word 'receipt'.

queries.question: For how long does my onboarding buddy support me?
queries.reference_answer: The buddy supports the new employee for their first 90 days.
queries.notes: Distractor in the same policy: probation check-ins at 30, 60 and 90 days (HR-004 section 6) also say '90 days'.

queries.question: How many days of paid leave do I get for jury duty?
queries.reference_answer: Refusal: no policy covers jury duty leave.
queries.notes: HR-001 lists many leave types with day counts - a tempting but wrong source.

queries.question: What is the maximum reimbursement for taxi fares on business trips?
queries.reference_answer: Refusal: the reimbursement policy does not mention taxis.
queries.notes: HR-003 has travel limits (hotel USD 180, meals USD 60, mileage USD 0.40) that could be misapplied.

queries.question: Does the company pay a monthly allowance for my mobile phone bill?
queries.reference_answer: Refusal: no policy describes a mobile phone allowance (only an internet allowance and company-issued equipment).
queries.notes: HR-002 internet allowance (USD 40 monthly) and IT-002 'mobile phones' are strong distractors.

queries.question: What dental insurance coverage do employees receive?
queries.reference_answer: Refusal: no policy covers insurance benefits.
queries.notes: Benefits topic not covered by any policy.

queries.question: Can I bring my dog to the office?
queries.reference_answer: Refusal: no policy covers pets or animals at the office.
queries.notes: Off-topic; no office-rules policy exists in this corpus.

queries.question: What can the Finance Controller approve?
queries.reference_answer: A late submission: expense claims submitted after 30 days are rejected unless the Finance Controller approves a late submission.
queries.notes: Replacement for exposed EV-06 (same category). Rare role name in the question. Same-policy distractors: HR-003 section 3 approvals by the line manager (all claims) and the department head (claims above USD 1,000, EV-13). Selected from the frozen catalog with no retrieval: unused by dev and other evaluation queries, self-contained, intact in all three chunking strategies (Phase 2 static analysis).
